messages:
alex m: Starting Kepler postmortem follow-up thread. Summary: transient VPC peering disconnects + on-prem routing churn exposed an isolation bug in tenant-controller. Need remediation owners, concrete timelines, and verification plan.

julia ops: Copying key postmortem note: when peer session resets repeatedly it causes controller to reconcile stale routes while async agent reapplies prefixes -> intermittent tenant isolation (~2-5m windows). We saw this in prod twice last week.

tony cs: Priority from customer: minimize next-occurrence risk and get a clear rollback plan for maintenance. They're sensitive to any config flips during business hours.

maria g: I'll take charge of the on-prem side: confirm router model, check vendor recommended configs, and escalate firmware if needed. Target: vendor findings + maint window options by 2026-05-04.

sanjay r: I'll own the controller patch. Plan: (1) add a per-tenant KV sync mutex, (2) introduce a 10s debounce before route pruning after peer restart, (3) add telemetry counters for "prune_attempts_after_restart". RFC + PR ETA: 2026-05-07.

alex m: Assigning owners/timelines: maria g -> vendor report by 2026-05-04; sanjay r -> RFC + PR by 2026-05-07; julia ops -> canary + dashboards by 2026-05-09.

julia ops: Canary plan: two non-prod tenants that mirror Kepler's prefix set, a synthetic flap generator (chaos job) that emulates 3 quick session resets, verbose BGP + controller logs. Will create Grafana panels: peer_restart_rate, stale_route_count, controller_mutex_waits. Canary start target: 2026-05-10.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster provisioned 1749999900, logging + metrics streaming enabled.

vendor-bot: vendor: router model NX-430 firmware 3.4.1 fixes aggressive session teardown; recommends enabling bgp-graceful-restart flag. Patch requires reload in maintenance window.

sanjay r: Repro notes for issue RW-9222: sequence -> peer flap x3 within 15s, concurrent agent reapply, controller prune wins and removes active routes. Log sample: ```ERROR tenant-ctrl: removed-route after concurrent-apply; route-owner mismatch: peer-restarted``` I'll attach full traces to the ticket.

alex m: Short-term mitigation: turn on bgp-graceful-restart for Kepler if vendor allows, and temporarily extend controller "safe-window" to 2 minutes for route prune in that tenant. Maria, can you confirm if vendor supports immediate config change without firmware?

maria g: Vendor says bgp-graceful-restart is a config flag available immediately for NX-430. They caution about memory overhead; will validate with Kepler during maint window. If customer refuses maint slot, we can enable a controller-level soft-safelist as fallback.

sanjay r: I'll include soft-safelist option in my RFC (toggleable per-tenant) so we can flip quickly if customer declines router changes. Also adding unit+integration tests to cover quick-reconnect scenarios.

julia ops: Updated the action tracker: owners, ticket links, RFC link, canary schedule, and CS maint proposals. Also added a weekly peering anomaly digest to surface long-term patterns.

alex m: Reconvene sync scheduled 2026-05-11 09:00 PT to review RFC + canary readiness. Closing criteria: merged controller PR, 48h clean canary, and either router config applied or controller fallback validated.

tony cs: I'll coordinate customer communication and get preferred maintenance windows. Asking Kepler for 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC as first choice.

infra-bot: alert: scheduled canary run 1750003600.

sanjay r: Quick note on tradeoffs in RFC: debounce increases time to reclaim truly orphaned routes by up to 2 minutes, but dramatically reduces customer-visible isolation during flappy sessions. Will include latency/cost telemetry to measure impact.

maria g: Vendor confirmed bgp-graceful-restart safe to enable for Kepler; recommending night window. Posting vendor doc link to the ticket.

julia ops: Canary dry-run shows decreased stale_route_count with a 10s debounce + safelist. Will run full 72h test once PR is merged.

alex m: Thanks team. If blockers appear, post here with status and link to action tracker. We'll mark items closed only after verification steps pass.
